# DeepSeek Harness trajectory source notice

English | [中文](NOTICE.zh.md)

JiuwenSwarm's trajectory renderer adapts source code and behavior from the following DeepSeek Harness source tree at commit `99f6f02fecdb7dff40c3fbc9470f5907c29f74ca`:

- `packages/client/ui-trajectory`
- `packages/client/ui-theme/src/styles`
- `packages/client/ui-primitives/src`

The adapted areas include the trajectory explorer, timeline and table presentation, theme tokens, Tooltip, Menu, JSON tree, Markdown and syntax-highlighted content presentation, KaTeX integration, and icons. JiuwenSwarm adds an OpenTelemetry projector, its own data transport, single-Agent host integration, and compatibility mappings.

The DeepSeek sources are distributed under the adjacent [MIT license](LICENSE). Copyright remains with DeepSeek and the other applicable copyright holders.
